interface.signature: def max_pleasure(A: str, B: str, N: int, S_b_pairs: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(T, int) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, str) and 1 <= len(A) <= 10**3 and all(c.islower() for c in A)
preconditions.description: A is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length up to 10^3.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(B, str) and 1 <= len(B) <= 10**3 and all(c.islower() for c in B)
preconditions.description: B is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length up to 10^3.
N is the number of favorite strings, an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S_b_pairs, list) and len(S_b_pairs) == N and all(isinstance(pair, tuple) and len(pair) == 2 for pair in S_b_pairs)
preconditions.description: S_b_pairs is a list of N tuples, where each tuple contains a string S_i and an integer b_i.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S_i, str) and 1 <= len(S_i) <= 26 and all(c.islower() for c in S_i) for S_i, b_i in S_b_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each S_i is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length up to 26.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(b_i, int) and 1 <= b_i <= 10**5 for S_i, b_i in S_b_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each b_i is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len({S_i for S_i, b_i in S_b_pairs}) == N

postconditions.expression: result == max(sum(b_i * count_substring(C, S_i) for S_i, b_i in S_b_pairs) for C in possible_Cs)
postconditions.description: The result is the maximum pleasure achievable by any concatenation C = A_s + B_s, where A_s is a substring of A (possibly empty) and B_s is a substring of B (possibly empty). The pleasure is calculated as the sum over all favorite strings S_i of (b_i multiplied by the number of times S_i appears as a substring in C).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(C, str) for C in possible_Cs) and all(len(C) <= len(A) + len(B) for C in possible_Cs)
postconditions.description: possible_Cs is the set of all possible concatenations C = A_s + B_s, where A_s is a substring of A and B_s is a substring of B.

postconditions.expression: def count_substring(s: str, sub: str) -> int: return sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - len(sub) + 1) if s[i:i+len(sub)] == sub)
postconditions.description: count_substring(s, sub) returns the number of times sub appears as a substring in s.
